description:
You are a fantasy fiction writer building a reference wiki for your novel series 'Shards of the Celestial War'. Using TiddlyWiki at http://localhost:8080, create a comprehensive world-building reference.

Create ALL of the following 6 tiddlers:

1. 'Celestial War - World Overview': The master world-building tiddler. Describe the world's setting (geography, cosmology, political structure). Include a table listing the major factions/kingdoms (Faction | Alignment | Territory | Leader | Primary Goal). Link to all other 5 tiddlers.

2. 'Celestial War - Factions and Politics': Detailed breakdown of at least 4 factions. Include a table: Faction | Type (empire/order/cabal/etc) | Alignment | Military Strength | Key Resources | Internal Conflict.

3. 'Celestial War - Characters': Profiles for at least 5 characters (a mix of heroes, villains, and supporting cast). Include a table: Name | Faction | Role | Age | Special Power/Skill | Motivation | First Appears In (act/chapter).

4. 'Celestial War - Magic System': Define the rules of magic in this world. Cover: source of magic, how it is learned/accessed, costs/limitations, and the spectrum of magical abilities. Include a table: Magic Type | Source | Practitioners | Strength | Limitation/Cost.

5. 'Celestial War - Timeline': A chronological history of the world from its creation myth through the present day and into the projected future of the series. Include a table: Era/Year | Event | Significance | Characters Involved | Impact on Present.

6. 'Celestial War - Glossary': Definitions of world-specific terms, places, artifacts, and lore. Include a table: Term | Category (place/magic/faction/artifact/creature) | Definition | First Mentioned In.

All 6 tiddlers must:
- Be tagged with both 'Fiction' and 'CelestialWar'
- Use TiddlyWiki headings (!! for major sections)
- Include at least one wiki table (| pipe syntax)
- Contain [[wikilinks]] cross-referencing other tiddlers in this set
- Contain at least 100 words each
- The Characters tiddler must have at least 5 named characters in its table

No login is required. The wiki is available at http://localhost:8080.
